description: Default capability: the main window may invoke the engine-bridge commands, and nothing else. The `shell` permission set (src-tauri/permissions/shell.json) is this app's ACL manifest — before it existed, Tauri let a *local*-origin invoke of any `codify_*` command through with no capability check at all, which is the bypass this capability now closes. It names the thirteen commands one by one rather than granting a wildcard, and `windows` is `["main"]` so nothing reaches a `browser-*` webview. No shell or filesystem scope is granted: the frontend only uses `invoke`, and the engine is spawned by the Rust backend over tokio, not through the shell plugin.
